default.title: Private integrations and managed pipeline Sheets
default.summary: ClawPilot separates encrypted per-user Maton settings from an owner-managed Google Workspace service account, adds private managed pipeline Sheets, and enforces pipeline-level sync isolation.
features: Separate Settings panels for per-user Maton accounts and the owner-managed Google API key, service account, and Shared Drive
Private per-user folders and operator Sheets in the selected Shared Drive, with durable Postgres projections and exact environment separation
Automatic eigenracing.com short links for managed pipeline Sheets without weakening Google file permissions
Pipeline sharing that mirrors viewer and editor membership into reader and writer permissions on the managed Google folder
fixes: Bound every pipeline pull, write, dropdown update, and queued operation to its authorized pipeline and Sheet pair
Made Maton key set and rotation validate the candidate key and refresh connection metadata atomically
Moved runtime platform mail to the encrypted owner Maton credential while retaining a bootstrap environment fallback
Kept managed tenant pipeline Google access on native service-account OAuth instead of a global Maton connection
Extended Railway backup policy checks to require daily, weekly, and monthly schedules in both environments
